description: Read the EV charge targets (`evc/gts`): the target state of charge per plug type (one entry for AC, one for DC). Verified live against a real vehicle. Read-only — makes no changes.

vehicle_key.description: Vehicle key (the `vehicleKey` from the vehicle-list tool). Not the VIN. Required: charging tools never default to the only vehicle.

name: kia_charge_targets
